describes: packages/plugin/redaction: marking from a selection and by area, the pending view, collateral, labels, the apply flow over the engine’s redaction service, remote applies, and the permission twins.

cases.name: initial-state-and-twins
cases.covers: A fresh slice is idle with no result. canMark is annotation create authority; canApply needs the engine service and all three of doc.redact, doc.pages.modify and doc.annotate.modify.

cases.name: mark-the-text-selection
cases.covers: queueCurrentSelection creates one redact markup per selected page from the segment quads, with the redact preset, clears the selection and resolves true; the marks then read back as text-kind pending items.

cases.name: marking-needs-create-authority
cases.covers: Without annotation create authority canMark is false and queueCurrentSelection resolves false without creating or clearing anything.

cases.name: the-redact-tool
cases.covers: enableRedact activates the composed redact tool; isRedactActive follows it; toggleRedact switches between redact and pointer. A drag off text under the tool draws an area mark, pending as area-kind.

cases.name: without-a-selection-plugin
cases.covers: Without the selection plugin the composed redact tool never registers: enableRedact and toggleRedact throw the hub’s unknown-tool error, and queueCurrentSelection resolves false.

cases.name: pending-projection
cases.covers: getPending projects every loaded redact annotation in page order: its model id (obj: and nm:), ref, page, display index, area or text kind, and overlay label. preparePending asks the annotation plane for every page and resolves.

cases.name: estimate-collateral
cases.covers: estimateCollateral counts the non-redact annotations whose rect has positive-area overlap with a mark’s quads (else its rect), for all marks, for the named ones, and for none.

cases.name: apply-named-marks
cases.covers: apply(ids) sends the matching pending refs as an annotations scope; the slice is applying until the engine answers, then records the result, fires onApplied and resolves with it. The unsubscribe stops later notifications and answers whether it removed anything.

cases.name: apply-all-pages
cases.covers: applyAll sends every page of the document as a pages scope, including pages without marks.

cases.name: apply-refused
cases.covers: An engine refusal ends the apply with a null result, which keeps the last result, and rejects with the engine’s error.

cases.name: apply-refusals-before-the-engine
cases.covers: apply rejects when no pending id matches (an empty list, no argument, an unknown id); applyAll rejects for a document with no pages; both reject without the engine redaction service. None of them dispatches.

$error.name: PluginError
$error.message: this engine has no redaction service

$error.name: PluginError
$error.message: this engine has no redaction service

cases.name: remote-applies-arrive-as-events
cases.covers: A redaction.applied event from a remote origin is recorded as the last result and fires onApplied; a local one (own applies flow through apply) and other event types are ignored. Closing the document releases the subscription.

cases.name: a-throwing-listener-is-isolated
cases.covers: A throwing onApplied callback is reported to console.error and the next callback still runs.

cases.name: set-label
cases.covers: setLabel writes the label fields the patch names (null clears the text) and always carries the mark’s current font family, size, colour and alignment; it rejects for a non-redact annotation and for an unknown ref.

$error.name: PluginError
$error.message: the target is not a redaction mark

$error.name: PluginError
$error.message: the target is not a redaction mark

cases.name: mark-area-and-page
cases.covers: markArea creates a redact annotation over a page-space rectangle with the redact tool and the configured overlay look (fill, label colour, family, and a size of 0); markPage covers the whole page. onPendingChanged fires for each redact creation and not for a square. markPage of a page the document lacks throws not-found; without create authority markArea and markPage throw permission-denied.

cases.name: an-overlay-without-values-adds-nothing
cases.covers: An overlay config whose fill and text members are all absent adds no props to a mark. A document with pages but no marks lists none.

cases.name: mark-search-matches
cases.covers: markMatches runs the search and creates one redact mark per hit from its segment quads, in hit order, skipping hits without segments; a pages filter keeps only the hits on those pages. Without a config the marks carry no overlay props.

cases.name: marking-refusals
cases.covers: markMatches rejects unsupported without a search plugin and permission-denied without create authority; markSelection rejects unsupported without a selection plugin once authority is there.

cases.name: unmark-and-clear
cases.covers: unmark deletes the refs that are pending marks through the annotation plane and reports every other ref as skipped; with no marks among them it resolves without touching the engine. clearPending unmarks every mark; a refused delete lands in failed. onPendingChanged fires once per deleted mark, with its page.

cases.name: apply-pages
cases.covers: applyPages rejects invalid-input for no pages and otherwise sends the given pages as a pages scope.

cases.name: pending-reads
cases.covers: getPending finds a mark by any ref kind and answers null for a non-mark; listPending with a page filter reads only that page (a page the document lacks has none), a filter without a page reads them all, and repeated reads answer the same marks. getPendingCount counts one page or all.

cases.name: update-label-refused
cases.covers: An engine refusal of a label edit rejects as a redaction PluginError; a later edit that lands fires onPendingChanged for the mark’s page.
